claim_boundary: Operational accounting of engineered dependencies. It is not a measure of intelligence and does not imply that every engineered component should be removed.

components.role: Enumerates the only procedures that can be acquired
components.candidate_replacement: learned proposal over a declared candidate interface; stronger claim requires held-out procedure families

components.role: Tests every hard-coded procedure against observations
components.candidate_replacement: learned proposer may rank or propose candidates, but verifier remains authoritative

components.role: Chooses an input where surviving candidates disagree
components.candidate_replacement: optional later learned evidence-request policy; not part of the first neural boundary

components.role: Supplies outputs for demonstrations, active probes and independent verification
components.implementation: oracle_for plus the callable passed to ProceduralLearner.learn
components.candidate_replacement: retain as an independent verifier in the first neural-assisted lifecycle

components.role: Runs the promoted procedure on unseen inputs
components.candidate_replacement: retain for the first inducer replacement

components.role: Stores versioned procedure metadata, evidence references, provenance and revision history
components.candidate_replacement: retain until neural retention is a separately approved boundary

components.role: Invalidates the active procedure after contradictory evidence
components.candidate_replacement: future learned contradiction detector; explicitly out of scope for the first neural inducer

components.role: Prevents promotion when multiple candidates remain
components.implementation: status=uncertain when candidate count is not one
components.candidate_replacement: learned confidence can be evaluated later, but cannot bypass deterministic verification

components.role: Defines primitive meanings, canonical ASTs and structural/functional novelty
components.candidate_replacement: retain as an independent semantic contract and verifier control

scaffolding_reduction_claim_requires: no loss of lifecycle gate reliability
no untracked increase in oracle access or evaluator intervention
explicit count of replaced and retained engineered components
